messages:
maya (PM): Hey team — I pushed a PRD + RFC draft for the new quotas/billing semantics here: https://redwood/intranet/rfc/billing-quota-draft. Need quick alignment on metering unit, overage behavior, API headers, and UI fields. Please review by EOD Thu.

alvin (Billing): Reading now. High-level: we should have a single canonical metering unit for hosted (token-equivalent) so billing math is consistent. For embeddings, charge per embedding unit (to avoid token ambiguity). Need clear rules for model-family premiums (e.g., large LLMs multiplier).

reza (Eng-Platform): Agree on canonical unit for hosted. Implementation notes: streaming responses can only finalize token count at end; we need incremental accounting and a way to surface provisional usage to customers. Suggest leaky-bucket counters per API key + per-route. Also important: counters must be deterministic across retries to avoid double-charging — include idempotency keys for billing.

maya (PM): Good. Two quick product decisions to make: 1) Over-limit behavior: hard 429 vs soft overage invoice? 2) Headers & API ergonomics for limits.

tess (Design): For Console UX — quota panel per-project with: current usage bar, projected spend (daily/weekly), soft-limit toggle (allow overage up to X with warning), and an alerts config (email/Slack). Keep the API error UX consistent with console.

sam (Support): Edge cases we see in support: billing races when model pricing changes mid-billing-cycle; retroactive credit when metering bug discovered; customers wanting a grace window during migration. Need acceptance criteria for how we handle each.

reza (Eng-Platform): RFC decision points I put in the doc but summarizing: 
1) Scope of limits: per-key (recommended) + optional per-route/per-model override for enterprise.
2) Burst vs sustained: token-bucket with burst capacity + sustained rate.
3) Error semantics: 429 for rate limiting. For invoice-triggered blocking (non-payment/overage on contractless accounts), consider 402 with clear messaging but fallback to 429 to avoid breaking clients that don't handle 402.

alvin (Billing): +1 to token-bucket. On 402: we should avoid sending 402 unless the account is flagged & we've notified them multiple times. Default: 429 + Retry-After header. For metered hosted customers, auto-overage should be allowed up to a small buffer (configurable per-account) before hard-blocking. Enterprise customers can opt-in to invoice-only blocking.

maya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria (please thumbs up / add):
- Metering unit defined and documented for each API (text-gen, chat, embeddings, rerank).
- Billing math reproducible from API logs and exported CSV.
- Rate-limit headers implemented: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset.
- 429 returned on hitting runtime rate limits with Retry-After (seconds).
- Soft-overage flow: allowed for hosted accounts with buffer flag; generates invoice line-item tagged as OVERAGE.
- Dedicated/private: by default consumption is not invoiced through hosted meter; usage reporting available for export.
- Idempotency keys prevent double billing on retries.
- Console UI: quota panel + soft-limit toggle + traffic forecast.

jon (SRE): Implementation note: we need efficient counters with TTL and sharded stores (redis + sharding). Also watch for thundering herd when limits reset — implement jittered reset windows. For X-RateLimit-Remaining we should provide best-effort estimates — warn in docs that streaming tally is provisional.

alvin (Billing): Edge-case list to include in PRD: 
- Model family price change mid-cycle (apply new price to future requests only; offer opt-in retrospective adjustment for admins).
- Tokens from cached responses (0 charge if from cache? or charge lower rate?) I propose charging reduced rate for cached completions (since compute is avoided but storage & retrieval costs exist).
- Cross-region reconciliation for customers with multi-region routing.

maya (PM): Decisions requested by Thu EOD: metering unit choice (final), soft-overage default (on/off), default behavior for dedicated/private, headers shape and field names, and acceptance criteria sign-off.

reza (Eng-Platform): Example header snippet for API responses I recommend: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1200
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 340
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1712345600  # unix epoch seconds
X-Usage-Provisional: 12345   # token-equivalent (provisional for streaming)
```
Clients should treat X-Usage-Provisional as advisory until final "usage-finalized" event or response end.

alvin (Billing): For billing exports, include per-request fields: timestamp, api_key_id (hashed), model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_flag, price_per_unit, total_charge_cents. That allows full audit.

maya (PM): Good. Also calling out acceptance test cases (add these to PRD): 
- Retry storm: client retries after 429 -> ensure idempotency prevents double billing.
- Streaming abort: client aborts halfway -> usage counted for tokens produced, no extra charging.
- Cache hit: response served from cache -> charge cache-rate and mark cached_flag=true.
- Quota change mid-cycle: user increases quota -> entitlement effective immediately; any auto-grants honored.
- Billing migration: customer moves from hosted to dedicated -> final hosted invoice includes credits for unused reserved capacity.

tess (Design): Small copy request for errors: 429 message should include human reason + machine parseable code field and link to support doc. E.g. 
```json
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"Project rate exceeded, retry after 10s","retry_after":10}
```

sam (Support): Add escalation path: when customers see unexpected 402/429, show "Contact billing" CTA that pre-populates account and usage snapshot.

maya (PM): I'll update PRD with these and push a last call review tomorrow morning. Who can own rollout telemetry? Need event list: rate_limit_triggered, soft_overage_allowed, overage_invoiced, quota_change, usage_finalized.

jon (SRE): I can own telemetry impl. Will add sampling for high-volume keys.

alvin (Billing): I'll own billing export schema and price-change policy text.

maya (PM): Thanks. Quick checklist for launch doc: Owners: Eng-Platform(reza/jon) Billing(alvin) Support(sam) Design(tess) QA(qa_owner). Rollout: canary to 1% keys -> 10% -> 100%. Telemetry verification at each step.

deploy-bot: created branch "rfc/billing-quota-edgecases" and opened PR 422.

maya (PM): Perfect — please add any missing edge cases in PRD comments. If no major objections by Thu EOD we'll lock decisions and start implementation sprint planning. :thumbsup:

alvin (Billing): +1

reza (Eng-Platform): +1

sam (Support): +1

jon (SRE): +1

maya (PM): Thanks everyone!
